Pset_ActorCommon.description: A property set that enables further classification of actors, including the ability to give a number of actors to be designated as a population, the number being specified as a property to be dealt with as a single value rather than having to aggregate a number of instances of IfcActor.

properties.name: NumberOfActors
properties.description: The number of actors that are to be dealt with together in the population.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Designation of the category into which the actors in the population belong.

properties.name: SkillLevel
properties.description: Skill level exhibited by the actor and which indicates an extent of their capability to perform actions on the artefacts upon which they can act.

Pset_WorkControlCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcWorkPlan and IfcWorkSchedule (subtypes of IfcWorkControl).

properties.name: WorkStartTime
properties.description: The default time of day a task is scheduled to start. For presentation purposes, if the start time of a task matches the WorkStartTime, then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the WorkStartTime.

properties.name: WorkFinishTime
properties.description: The default time of day a task is scheduled to finish. For presentation purposes, if the finish time of a task matches the WorkFinishTime, then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the WorkFinishTime.

properties.name: WorkDayDuration
properties.description: The elapsed time within a worktime-based day. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work days where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 24 hours (an elapsed day); if omitted then 8 hours is assumed.

properties.name: WorkWeekDuration
properties.description: The elapsed time within a worktime-based week. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work weeks where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 168 hours (an elapsed week); if omitted then 40 hours is assumed.

properties.name: WorkMonthDuration
properties.description: The elapsed time within a worktime-based month. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work months where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 744 hours (an elapsed month of 31 days); if omitted then 160 hours is assumed.

Pset_AnnotationContourLine.description: Specifies parameters of a standard curve that has a single, consistent measure value.

properties.name: ContourValue
properties.description: Value of the elevation of the contour above or below a reference plane.

Pset_AnnotationLineOfSight.description: Specifies the properties of the line of sight at a point of connection between two elements. Typically used to define the line of sight visibility at the junction between two roads (particularly between an access road and a public road).

properties.name: SetbackDistance
properties.description: Setback distance from the point of connection on the major element along the axis of the minor element (e.g. distance from a public road at which the line of sigfht is measured.

properties.name: VisibleAngleLeft
properties.description: Angle of visibility to the left of the access.

properties.name: VisibleAngleRight
properties.description: Angle of visibility to the right of the access.

properties.name: RoadVisibleDistanceLeft
properties.description: Distance visible to the left of the access.

properties.name: RoadVisibleDistanceRight
properties.description: Distance visible to the right of the access.

Pset_AnnotationSurveyArea.description: Specifies particular properties of survey methods to be assigned to survey point set or resulting surface patches

properties.name: AcquisitionMethod
properties.description: The means by which survey data was acquired.

properties.name: AccuracyQualityObtained
properties.description: A measure of the accuracy quality of survey points as obtained expressed in percentage terms.

properties.name: AccuracyQualityExpected
properties.description: A measure of the accuracy quality of survey points as expected expressed in percentage terms.

Pset_BuildingCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuilding. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuilding instance, the building number (or short name) by IfcBuilding.Name, the building name (or long name) by IfcBuilding.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuilding.Description. Actual building quantities, like building perimeter, building area and building volume are provided by IfcElementQuantity, and the building classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal project type.

properties.name: BuildingID
properties.description: A unique identifier assigned to a building. A temporary identifier is initially assigned at the time of making a planning application. This temporary identifier is changed to a permanent identifier when the building is registered into a statutory buildings and properties database.

properties.name: IsPermanentID
properties.description: Indicates whether the identity assigned to a building is permanent (= TRUE) or temporary (=FALSE).

properties.name: ConstructionMethod
properties.description: The type of construction action to the building, the project deals with, e.g. new construction, renovation, refurbishment, etc.

properties.name: FireProtectionClass
properties.description: Main fire protection class for the building which is assigned from the fire protection classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: OccupancyType
properties.description: Occupancy type for this object.\X\0AIt is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned gross area for the building  Used for programming the building.

properties.name: NetPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned net area for the building  Used for programming the building.

properties.name: NumberOfStoreys
properties.description: The number of storeys within a building.\X\0ACaptured for those cases where the IfcBuildingStorey entity is not used. Note that if IfcBuilingStorey is asserted and the number of storeys in a building can be determined from it, then this approach should be used in preference to setting a property for the number of storeys.

properties.name: YearOfConstruction
properties.description: Year of construction of this building, including expected year of completion.

properties.name: YearOfLastRefurbishment
properties.description: Year of last major refurbishment, or reconstruction, of the building (applies to reconstruction works).

properties.name: IsLandmarked
properties.description: This builing is listed as a historic building (TRUE), or not (FALSE), or unknown.

Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingStorey. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuildingStorey instance, the building storey number (or short name) by IfcBuildingStorey.Name, the building storey name (or long name) by IfcBuildingStorey.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuildingStorey.Description. Actual building storey quantities, like building storey perimeter, building storey area and building storey volume are provided by IfcElementQuantity, and the building storey classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal project type.

properties.name: EntranceLevel
properties.description: Indication whether this building storey is an entrance level to the building (TRUE), or (FALSE) if otherwise.

properties.name: AboveGround
properties.description: Indication whether this building storey is fully above ground (TRUE), or below ground (FALSE), or partially above and below ground (UNKNOWN) - as in sloped terrain.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X\0AIt should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: LoadBearingCapacity
properties.description: Maximum load bearing capacity of the floor structure throughtout the storey as designed.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

properties.name: NetPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned net area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

Pset_BuildingUse.description: Provides information on on the real estate context of the building of interest both current and anticipated.

properties.name: MarketCategory
properties.description: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

properties.name: MarketSubCategory
properties.description: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise.

properties.name: PlanningControlStatus
properties.description: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

properties.name: NarrativeText
properties.description: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description.

properties.name: VacancyRateInCategoryNow
properties.description: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category currently.

properties.name: TenureModesAvailableNow
properties.description: A list of the tenure modes that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

properties.name: MarketSubCategoriesAvailableNow
properties.description: A list of the sub categories of property that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

properties.name: RentalRatesInCategoryNow
properties.description: Range of the cost rates for property currently available in the required category.

properties.name: VacancyRateInCategoryFuture
properties.description: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category expected in the future.

properties.name: TenureModesAvailableFuture
properties.description: A list of the tenure modes that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

properties.name: MarketSubCategoriesAvailableFuture
properties.description: A list of the sub categories of property that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

properties.name: RentalRatesInCategoryFuture
properties.description: Range of the cost rates for property expected to be available in the future in the required category.

Pset_BuildingUseAdjacent.description: Provides information on adjacent buildings and their uses to enable their impact on the building of interest to be determined. Note that for each instance of the property set used, where there is an existence of risk, there will be an instance of the property set Pset_Risk (q.v).

properties.name: MarketCategory
properties.description: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

properties.name: MarketSubCategory
properties.description: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise.

properties.name: PlanningControlStatus
properties.description: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

properties.name: NarrativeText
properties.description: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description.

Pset_CivilElementCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrence and type objects of civil element.

Pset_ElementAssemblyCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrence and type objects of element assembly.

Pset_EnvironmentalImpactIndicators.description: Environmental impact indicators are related to a given \X2\201C\X0\functional unit\X2\201D\X0\ (ISO 14040 concept). An example of functional unit is a "Double glazing window with PVC frame" and the unit to consider is "one square meter of opening elements filled by this product\X2\201D\X0\.\X\0AIndicators values are valid for the whole life cycle or only a specific phase (see LifeCyclePhase property). Values of all the indicators are expressed per year according to the expected service life. The first five properties capture the characteristics of the functional unit. The following properties are related to environmental indicators.\X\0AThere is a consensus agreement international for the five one. Last ones are not yet fully and formally agreed at the international level.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project

properties.name: FunctionalUnitReference
properties.description: Reference to a database or a classification

properties.name: Unit
properties.description: The unit of the quantity the environmental indicators values are related with.

properties.name: LifeCyclePhase
properties.description: The whole life cycle or only a given phase  from which environmental data are valid.

properties.name: ExpectedServiceLife
properties.description: Expected service life in years.

properties.name: TotalPrimaryEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

properties.name: WaterConsumptionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of water used.

properties.name: HazardousWastePerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of hazardous waste generated

properties.name: NonHazardousWastePerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated

properties.name: ClimateChangePerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2

properties.name: AtmosphericAcidificationPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2

properties.name: RenewableEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: NonRenewableEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: ResourceDepletionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony

properties.name: InertWastePerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of inert waste generated

properties.name: RadioactiveWastePerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of radioactive waste generated

properties.name: StratosphericOzoneLayerDestructionPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11

properties.name: PhotochemicalOzoneFormationPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene

properties.name: EutrophicationPerUnit
properties.description: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4

Pset_EnvironmentalImpactValues.description: The following properties capture environmental impact values of an element. They correspond to the indicators defined into Pset_EnvironmentalImpactIndicators. \X\0AEnvironmental impact values are obtained multiplying indicator value per unit by the relevant quantity of the element.

properties.name: TotalPrimaryEnergyConsumption
properties.description: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

properties.name: WaterConsumption
properties.description: Quantity of water used.

properties.name: HazardousWaste
properties.description: Quantity of hazardous waste generated.

properties.name: NonHazardousWaste
properties.description: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated.

properties.name: ClimateChange
properties.description: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2.

properties.name: AtmosphericAcidification
properties.description: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2.

properties.name: RenewableEnergyConsumption
properties.description: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: NonRenewableEnergyConsumption
properties.description: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: ResourceDepletion
properties.description: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony.

properties.name: InertWaste
properties.description: Quantity of inert waste generated .

properties.name: RadioactiveWaste
properties.description: Quantity of radioactive waste generated.

properties.name: StratosphericOzoneLayerDestruction
properties.description: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11.

properties.name: PhotochemicalOzoneFormation
properties.description: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene.

properties.name: Eutrophication
properties.description: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4.

properties.name: LeadInTime
properties.description: Lead in time before start of process.

properties.name: Duration
properties.description: Duration of process.

properties.name: LeadOutTime
properties.description: Lead out time after end of process.

Pset_LandRegistration.description: Specifies the identity of land within a statutory registration system. \X\0D\X\0A\X\0D\X\0A<blockquote NOTE: The property LandTitleID is to be used in preference to deprecated attribute LandTitleNumber in IfcSite.

properties.name: LandID
properties.description: Identification number assigned by the statutory registration authority to a land parcel.

properties.name: IsPermanentID
properties.description: Indicates whether the identity assigned to a land parcel is permanent (= TRUE) or temporary (=FALSE).

properties.name: LandTitleID
properties.description: Identification number assigned by the statutory registration authority to the title to a land parcel.

Pset_OpeningElementCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcOpeningElement.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal construction type.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: Purpose
properties.description: Indication of the purpose for that opening, e.g. 'ventilation', 'access', etc.

properties.name: FireExit
properties.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X\0AHere whether the space (in case of e.g., a corridor) is designed to serve as an exit space, e.g., for fire escape purposes.

properties.name: ProtectedOpening
properties.description: Indication whether the opening is considered to be protected under fire safety considerations. If (TRUE) it counts as a protected opening under the applicable building code, (FALSE) otherwise.

Pset_SiteCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSite. Please note that several site attributes are handled directly at the IfcSite instance, the site number (or short name) by IfcSite.Name, the site name (or long name) by IfcSite.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSite.Description. The land title number is also given as an explicit attribute IfcSite.LandTitleNumber. Actual site quantities, like site perimeter, site area and site volume are provided by IfcElementQuantity, and site classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The global positioning of the site in terms of Northing and Easting and height above sea level datum is given by IfcSite.RefLongitude, IfcSite.RefLatitude, IfcSite.RefElevation and the postal address by IfcSite.SiteAddress.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal project type.

properties.name: BuildableArea
properties.description: The area of site utilization expressed as a maximum value according to local building codes.

properties.name: SiteCoverageRatio
properties.description: The ratio of the utilization,  TotalArea / BuildableArea, expressed as a maximum value. The ratio value may be used to derive BuildableArea.

properties.name: FloorAreaRatio
properties.description: The ratio of all floor areas to the buildable area as the maximum floor area utilization of the site as a maximum value according to local building codes.

properties.name: BuildingHeightLimit
properties.description: Allowed maximum height of buildings on this site - according to local building codes.

properties.name: TotalArea
properties.description: Total planned area for the site. Used for programming the site space.

Pset_SpaceCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace. Please note that several space attributes are handled directly at the IfcSpace instance, the space number (or short name) by IfcSpace.Name, the space name (or long name) by IfcSpace:LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSpace.Description. Actual space quantities, like space perimeter, space area and space volume are provided by IfcElementQuantity, and space classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The level above zero (relative to the building) for the slab row construction is provided by the IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation, the level above zero (relative to the building) for the floor finish is provided by the IfcSpace.ElevationWithFlooring.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal project type.

properties.name: IsExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned gross area for the space. Used for programming the space.

properties.name: NetPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned net area for the space. Used for programming the space.

properties.name: PubliclyAccessible
properties.description: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as a publicly accessible space, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HandicapAccessible
properties.description: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as an accessible space for handicapped people, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE). This information is often used to declare the need for access for the disabled and for special design requirements of this space.

Pset_SpaceCoveringRequirements.description: Properties common to the definition of covering requirements of IfcSpace. Those properties define the requirements coming from a space program in early project phases and can later be used to define the room book information, if such coverings are not modeled explicitly as covering elements.

properties.name: FloorCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.\X\0A\X\0AThe material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: FloorCoveringThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space flooring.  \X\0A\X\0AThe thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: WallCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.\X\0A\X\0AThe material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: WallCoveringThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space cladding.  \X\0A\X\0AThe thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: CeilingCovering
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.\X\0A\X\0AThe material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CEILING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: CeilingCoveringThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space ceiling.  \X\0A\X\0AThe thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CEILING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: SkirtingBoard
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or construction of the skirting board around the space flooring. The label is used for room book information.\X\0A\X\0AThe material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: SkirtingBoardHeight
properties.description: Height of the skirting board.\X\0A\X\0AThe height information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the height assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: Molding
properties.description: Label to indicate the material or construction of the molding around the space ceiling. The label is used for room book information.\X\0A\X\0AThe material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=MOLDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: MoldingHeight
properties.description: Height of the molding.\X\0A\X\0AThe height information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=MOLDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the height assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

properties.name: ConcealedFlooring
properties.description: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed flooring space is normally meant to be the space beneath a raised floor.

properties.name: ConcealedFlooringOffset
properties.description: Distance between the floor slab and the floor covering, often used for cables and other installations. Often referred to as raised flooring.

properties.name: ConcealedCeiling
properties.description: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed ceiling space is normally meant to be the space between a slab and a ceiling.

properties.name: ConcealedCeilingOffset
properties.description: Distance between the upper floor slab and the suspended ceiling, often used for distribution systems. Often referred to as plenum.

Pset_SpaceFireSafetyRequirements.description: Properties related to fire protection of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone.

properties.name: FireRiskFactor
properties.description: Fire Risk factor assigned to the space according to local building regulations. It defines the fire risk of the space at several levels of fire hazard.

properties.name: FlammableStorage
properties.description: Indication whether the space is intended to serve as a storage of flammable material (which is regarded as such by the presiding building code. (TRUE) indicates yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: FireExit
properties.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X\0AHere whether the space (in case of e.g., a corridor) is designed to serve as an exit space, e.g., for fire escape purposes.

properties.name: SprinklerProtection
properties.description: Indication whether the space is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
properties.description: Indication whether the space has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X\0AIt should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: AirPressurization
properties.description: Indication whether the space is required to have pressurized air (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Pset_SpaceLightingRequirements.description: Properties related to the lighting requirements that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace or IfcZone. This includes the required artificial lighting, illuminance, etc.

properties.name: ArtificialLighting
properties.description: Indication whether this space  requires artificial lighting (as natural lighting would be not sufficient). (TRUE) indicates yes (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: Illuminance
properties.description: Required average illuminance value for this space.

Pset_SpaceOccupancyRequirements.description: Properties concerning work activities occurring or expected to occur within one or a set of similar spatial structure elements.

properties.name: OccupancyType
properties.description: Occupancy type for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

properties.name: OccupancyNumber
properties.description: Number of people required for the activity assigned to this space.

properties.name: OccupancyNumberPeak
properties.description: Maximal number of people required for the activity assigned to this space in peak time.

properties.name: OccupancyTimePerDay
properties.description: The amount of time during the day that the activity is required within this space.

properties.name: AreaPerOccupant
properties.description: Design occupancy loading for this type of usage assigned to this space.

properties.name: MinimumHeadroom
properties.description: Headroom required for the activity assigned to this space.

properties.name: IsOutlookDesirable
properties.description: An indication of whether the outlook is desirable (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE)

Pset_SpaceParking.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace which have an attribute value for ObjectType = 'Parking'. NOTE: Modified in IFC 2x3, properties ParkingUse and ParkingUnits added.

properties.name: ParkingUse
properties.description: Identifies the type of transporation for which the parking space is designed. Values are not predefined but might include car, compact car, motorcycle, bicycle, truck, bus etc.

properties.name: ParkingUnits
properties.description: Indicates the number of transporation units of the type specified by the property ParkingUse that may be accommodated within the space. Generally, this value should default to 1 unit. However, where the parking space is for motorcycles or bicycles, provision may be made for more than one unit in the space.

properties.name: IsAisle
properties.description: Indicates that this parking zone is for accessing the parking units, i.e. an aisle (TRUE) and not a parking unit itself (FALSE)

properties.name: IsOneWay
properties.description: Indicates whether the parking aisle is designed for oneway traffic (TRUE) or twoway traffic (FALSE). Should only be provided if the property IsAisle is set to TRUE.

Pset_SpaceThermalRequirements.description: Properties related to the comfort requirements for thermal and other  thermal related performance properties of spaces that apply to the occurrences of IfcSpace, IfcSpatialZone or IfcZone. It can also be used to capture requirements for IfcSpaceType's. This includes the required design temperature, humidity, ventilation, and air conditioning.

properties.name: SpaceTemperature
properties.description: Temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period. Provide this value, if no temperatur range (Min-Max) is available.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureMax
properties.description: Maximal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureSummerMax
properties.description: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureSummerMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureWinterMax
properties.description: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

properties.name: SpaceTemperatureWinterMin
properties.description: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

properties.name: SpaceHumidity
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period. Provide this property, if no humidity range (Min-Max) is available.

properties.name: SpaceHumidityMax
properties.description: Maximal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceHumidityMin
properties.description: Minimal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

properties.name: SpaceHumiditySummer
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

properties.name: SpaceHumidityWinter
properties.description: Humidity of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

properties.name: DiscontinuedHeating
properties.description: Indication whether discontinued heating is required/desirable from user/designer view point. (TRUE) if yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

properties.name: NaturalVentilation
properties.description: Indication whether the space is required to have natural ventilation (TRUE) or mechanical ventilation (FALSE).

properties.name: NaturalVentilationRate
properties.description: Indication of the requirement of a particular natural air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

properties.name: MechanicalVentilationRate
properties.description: Indication of the requirement of a particular mechanical air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

properties.name: AirConditioning
properties.description: Indication whether this space requires air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: AirConditioningCentral
properties.description: Indication whether the space  requires a central air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).\X\0AIt should only be given, if the property "AirConditioning" is set to TRUE.

properties.name: IsExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external zone at the outside of the building.

Pset_TransportElementCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement or IfcTransportElementType

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'). Used to store the non-classification driven internal construction type.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: CapacityPeople

properties.name: CapacityWeight

properties.name: FireExit

Pset_TransportElementElevator.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement with the predefined type ="ELEVATOR"

properties.name: FireFightingLift
properties.description: Indication whether the elevator is designed to serve as a fire fighting lift the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A fire fighting lift is used by fire fighters to access the location of fire and to evacuate people.

properties.name: ClearWidth
properties.description: Clear width of the object (elevator). properties.name: ClearHeight
properties.description: Clear height of the object (elevator).  \X\0AThe shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. Pset_ZoneCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcZone.

properties.name: IsExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external zone at the outside of the building.

properties.name: GrossPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned gross area for the zone. Used for programming the zone.

properties.name: NetPlannedArea
properties.description: Total planned net area for the zone. Used for programming the zone.

properties.name: PubliclyAccessible
properties.description: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as a publicly accessible space, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HandicapAccessible

This information is often used to declare the need for access for the disabled and for special design requirements of this space.

Qto_BuildingBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of building.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Standard gross height of this building, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the top surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

properties.name: EavesHeight
properties.description: Standard net height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the bottom surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

properties.name: FootprintArea
properties.description: Gross area of the site covered by the building(s).

properties.name: GrossFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all gross areas of spaces within the building. It includes the area of construction elements within the building. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces and the construction elements assigend to the building. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces and construction elements take precedence.

properties.name: NetFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all net areas of spaces within the building. It excludes the area of construction elements within the building. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces assigend to the building. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces take precedence.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Sum of all gross volumes of spaces enclosed by the building. It includes the volumes of construction elements within the building. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces and the construction elements assigend to the building. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces and construction elements take precedence.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Sum of all net volumes of spaces enclosed by the building. It iexcludes the volumes of construction elements within the building. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces assigend to the building. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces take precedence.

Qto_BuildingStoreyBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of building storey.

properties.name: GrossHeight
properties.description: Standard gross height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the top surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

properties.name: NetHeigtht
properties.description: Standard net height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the bottom surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

properties.name: GrossPerimeter
properties.description: Perimeter of the outer contour of the building story without taking interior slab openings into account.

properties.name: GrossFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all gross areas of spaces within the building storey. It includes the area of construction elements within the building storey. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces and the construction elements assigend to the storey. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces and construction elements take precedence.

properties.name: NetFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all net areas of spaces within the building storey. It excludes the area of construction elements within the building storey. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces assigend to the storey. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces take precedence.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Sum of all gross volumes of spaces enclosed by the building storey. It includes the volumes of construction elements within the building storey. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces and the construction elements assigend to the storey. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces and construction elements take precedence.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Sum of all net volumes of spaces enclosed by the building storey. It iexcludes the volumes of construction elements within the building storey. May be provided in addition to the quantities of the spaces assigend to the storey. In case of inconsistencies, the individual quantities of spaces take precedence.

Qto_OpeningElementBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of opening elements.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Width of the opening, in case of wall openings it is the horizontal dimension in case of slab openings it is one horizontal dimension. Only provided, if the area is rectangular.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Height of the opening, in case of wall openings it is the vertical dimension in case of slab openings it is one horizontal dimension. Only provided, if the area is rectangular.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Depth (or thickness) of the opening, in case of openings it shall be identical to the width (or thickness) of the voided element, in case of recesses it shall be less. Only provided, if the depth is constant.

properties.name: Area
properties.description: Area of the opening as viewed by an elevation view (for wall openings) or as viewed by a ground floor view (for slab openings).

properties.name: Volume
properties.description: Volume of the opening. It is the subtraction volume of the opening from the voided element (e.g. wall or slab). In case that the geometric volume of the opening is bigger then the subtraction volume, only the subtraction volume should be used.

Qto_ProjectionElementBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of projection elements.

properties.name: Area
properties.description: Area of the projection as viewed by an elevation view (for wall projections or as viewed by a ground floor view (for slab projections).

properties.name: Volume
properties.description: Volume of the opening. It is the addition volume of the project to the element (e.g. wall or slab).

Qto_SiteBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of site.

properties.name: GrossPerimeter
properties.description: Perimeter of the site boundary, measured in horizontal projection.

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Gross area for this site, measured in horizontal projections.

Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of spaces.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total height (from base slab without flooring to ceiling without suspended ceiling) for this space (measured from top of slab below to bottom of slab above). To be provided only if the space has a constant height.

properties.name: FinishCeilingHeight
properties.description: Height of the suspended ceiling (from top of flooring to the bottom of the suspended ceiling). To be provided only if the space has a suspended ceiling with constant height.

properties.name: FinishFloorHeight
properties.description: Height of the flooring (from base slab without flooring to the flooring height). To be provided only if the space has a constant flooring height.

properties.name: GrossPerimeter
properties.description: Gross perimeter at the floor level of this space. It all sides of the space, including those parts of the perimeter that are created by virtual boundaries and openings (like doors).

properties.name: NetPerimeter
properties.description: Net perimeter at the floor level of this space. It excludes those parts of the perimeter that are created by by virtual boundaries and openings (like doors). It is the measurement used for skirting boards and may includes the perimeter of internal fixed objects like columns.

properties.name: GrossFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all floor areas covered by the space. It includes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.) and excludes the area covered by wall claddings.

properties.name: NetFloorArea
properties.description: Sum of all usable floor areas covered by the space. It excludes the area covered  by elements inside the space (columns, inner walls, built-in's etc.), slab openings, or other protruding elements. Varying heights are not taking into account (i.e. no reduction for areas under a minimum headroom).

properties.name: GrossWallArea
properties.description: Sum of all wall (and other vertically bounding elements, like columns) areas bounded by the space. It includes the area covered by elements inside the wall area (doors, windows, other openings, etc.).

properties.name: NetWallArea
properties.description: Sum of all wall (and other vertically bounding elements, like columns) areas bounded by the space. It excludes the area covered by elements inside the wall area (doors, windows, other openings, etc.).

properties.name: GrossCeilingArea
properties.description: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It includes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

properties.name: NetCeilingArea
properties.description: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It excludes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Gross volume enclosed by the space, including the volume of construction elements inside the space.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Net volume enclosed by the space, excluding the volume of construction elements inside the space.

Pset_BeamCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrence and type objects of beam.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: Span
properties.description: Clear span for this object.\X\0A\X\0AThe shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence. For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.

properties.name: Slope
properties.description: Slope angle - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).\X\0A\X\0AThe shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.  For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.

properties.name: Roll
properties.description: Rotation against the longitudinal axis - relative to the global Z direction for all beams that are non-vertical in regard to the global coordinate system (Profile direction equals global Z is Roll = 0.)\X\0A\X\0AThe shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.  For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.\X\0A\X\0ANote: new property in IFC4

properties.name: IsExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

properties.name: ThermalTransmittance
properties.description: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of the element. Here the total thermal transmittance coefficient through the beam within the direction of the thermal flow (including all materials).\X\0A\X\0ANote: new property in IFC4

properties.name: LoadBearing
properties.description: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: FireRating
properties.description: Fire rating for the element. It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

properties.name: GlassLayers
properties.description: Number of glass layers within the frame. E.g. "2" for double glazing.

properties.description: Thickness of the first (inner) glass layer.

properties.description: Thickness of the second (intermediate or outer) glass layer.

properties.name: GlassThickness3
properties.description: Thickness of the third (outer) glass layer.

properties.name: FillGas
properties.description: Name of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

properties.name: GlassColor
properties.description: Color (tint) selection for this glazing. It is given for information purposes only.

properties.name: IsTempered
properties.description: Indication whether the glass is tempered (TRUE) or not (FALSE) .

properties.name: IsLaminated
properties.description: Indication whether the glass is layered with other materials (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: IsCoated
properties.description: Indication whether the glass is coated with a material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: IsWired
properties.description: Indication whether the glass includes a contained wire mesh to prevent break-in (TRUE) or not (FALSE)

properties.name: VisibleLightReflectance
properties.description: Fraction of the visible light that is reflected by the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

properties.name: VisibleLightTransmittance
properties.description: Fraction of the visible light that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

properties.name: SolarAbsorption
properties.description: (Asol) The ratio of incident solar radiation that is absorbed by a glazing system. It is the sum of the absorption distributed to the exterior (a) and to the interior (qi). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: SolarReflectance
properties.description: (Rsol): The ratio of incident solar radiation that is reflected by a glazing system (also named \X2\03C1\X0\e). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: SolarTransmittance
properties.description: (Tsol): The ratio of incident solar radiation that directly passes through a glazing system (also named \X2\03C4\X0\e). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: SolarHeatGainTransmittance
properties.description: (SHGC): The ratio of incident solar radiation that contributes to the heat gain of the interior, it is the solar radiation that directly passes (Tsol or \X2\03C4\X0\e) plus the part of the absorbed radiation that is distributed to the interior (qi). The SHGC is refered to also as g-value (g = \X2\03C4\X0\e + qi).

properties.name: ShadingCoefficient
properties.description: (SC): The measure of the ability of a glazing to transmit solar heat, relative to that ability for 3 mm (1/8-inch) clear, double-strength, single glass. Shading coefficient is being phased out in favor of the solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC), and is approximately equal to the SHGC multiplied by 1.15. The shading coefficient is expressed as a number without units between 0 and 1.

properties.name: ThermalTransmittanceSummer
properties.description: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.\X\0ASummer thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).

properties.name: ThermalTransmittanceWinter
properties.description: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.\X\0AWinter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).
