properties.description: Indicates whether the object extend to the structure above (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Compartmentation
properties.description: Indication whether the object is designed to serve as a fire compartmentation (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Pset_WindowCommon.description: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of Window.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: AcousticRating
properties.description: Acoustic rating for this object.\X\0AIt is provided according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ratio (instead of providing full sound absorbtion values).

properties.name: FireRating
properties.description: Fire rating for this object.\X\0AIt is given according to the national fire safety classification.

properties.name: SecurityRating
properties.description: Index based rating system indicating security level.\X\0AIt is giving according to the national building code.

properties.name: IsExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

properties.name: Infiltration
properties.description: Infiltration flowrate of outside air for the filler object based on the area of the filler object at a pressure level of 50 Pascals. It shall be used, if the length of all joints is unknown.

properties.name: ThermalTransmittance
properties.description: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.\X\0AIt applies to the total door construction.

properties.name: GlazingAreaFraction
properties.description: Fraction of the glazing area relative to the total area of the filling element. \X\0AIt shall be used, if the glazing area is not given separately for all panels within the filling element.

properties.name: HasSillExternal
properties.description: Indication whether the window opening has an external sill (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HasSillInternal
properties.description: Indication whether the window opening has an internal sill (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HasDrive
properties.description: Indication whether this object has an automatic drive to operate it (TRUE) or no drive (FALSE)

properties.name: SmokeStop
properties.description: Indication whether the object is designed to provide a smoke stop (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: FireExit
properties.description: Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE). Here it defines an exit window in accordance to the national building code.

properties.name: WaterTightnessRating
properties.description: Water tightness rating for this object.\X\0AIt is provided according to the national building code.

properties.name: MechanicalLoadRating
properties.description: Mechanical load rating for this object.\X\0AIt is provided according to the national building code.

properties.name: WindLoadRating
properties.description: Wind load resistance rating for this object.\X\0AIt is provided according to the national building code.

Qto_BeamBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of beams.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the beam, not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the beam.

properties.name: OuterSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded surfaces of the beam (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length.

properties.name: GrossSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the beam, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

properties.name: NetSurfaceArea
properties.description: Net surface area of the beam, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the beam, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the beam, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the beam without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the beam without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_ChimneyBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of chimneys.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the chimney from the foundation (or beginning) to the top not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of columns.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the column not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the column.

properties.name: OuterSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded surfaces of the column (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length.

properties.name: GrossSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the column, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

properties.name: NetSurfaceArea
properties.description: Net surface area of the column, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the column, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the column, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the column without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the column without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_CoveringBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of coverings applied to spaces.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Nominal width (or thickness) of the plate. Only given, if the covering is prismatic (constant thickess).

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Sum of all gross areas of the covering facing the space. No opening that is included in the covering is subtracted.

properties.name: NetArea
properties.description: Sum of all net areas  of the covering facing the space. All openings that is included in the covering are subtracted.

Qto_CurtainWallQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of curtain walls.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the curtain wall along the cutain wall center line (even if different to the curtain wall path).

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total height of the curtain wall. It should only be provided, if it is constant along the curtain wall path.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Thickness of the curtain wall. It should only be provided, if it is constant along the curtain wall path.

properties.name: GrossSideArea
properties.description: Area of the curtain wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the curtain wall.  It does not take into account any curtain wall modifications.

properties.name: NetSideArea
properties.description: Area of the curtain wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the curtain wall. It does take into account all curtain wall modifications.

Qto_DoorBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of doors.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Total outer width of the door lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular door.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total outer heigth of the door lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular door.

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Total perimeter of the outer lining of the door.

properties.name: Area
properties.description: Total area of the outer lining of the door.

Qto_MemberBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of members.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total nominal length of the member, not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the member.

properties.name: OuterSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded surfaces of the member (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length.

properties.name: GrossSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the member, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

properties.name: NetSurfaceArea
properties.description: Net surface area of the member, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the member, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the member, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the member without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the member without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_PlateBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of plates.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Nominal width (or thickness) of the plate. Only given, if the plate is prismatic (constant thickess).

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Perimeter measured along the outer boundaries of the plate. Only given, if the plate is prismatic (constant thickness).

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded area of the plate. Openings, recesses and projections are not taken into account. Only given, if the plate is prismatic.

properties.name: NetArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded area of the plate. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition. Only given, if the plate is prismatic.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the plate. Openings, recesses, and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the plate. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the plate without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the plate without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_RailingBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of railings.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total nominal length of the railing, not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

Qto_RampFlightBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of ramp flights.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the ramp flight along the walking line.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Thickness of the ramp flight. It should only be provided, if it is constant.

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Total area of the ramp flight (not the projected area). Openings, recesses and projections are not taken into account. Only given, if the ramp flight is prismatic.

properties.name: NetArea
properties.description: Total area of the ramp flight (not the projected area). Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition. Only given, if the ramp flight is prismatic.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the ramp flight. Openings, recesses, and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the ramp flight. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition.

Qto_RoofBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of roof.

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Total gross area of the outer surface of the roof. It is the sum of all roof slab gross areas. Roof openings, like sky windows and other openings and cut-outs are not taken into account.

properties.name: NetArea
properties.description: Total net area of the outer surface of the roof. It is the suma of all roof slab net areas. Roof openings, like sky windows and other openings and cut-outs are taken into account.

properties.name: ProjectedArea
properties.description: Total gross area of the outer surfaces of the roof, projected tp the ground. It is the sum of all projected roof slab gross areas. Roof openings, like sky windows and other openings and cut-outs are not taken into account.

Qto_SlabBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of slabs.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Nominal width (or thickness) of the slab. Only given, if the slab is prismatic (constant thickess).

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Length (one direction of the non-projected foot print area) of the slab. It shall only be provided, if the slab is rectangular.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description:
Depth (one direction of the non-projected foot print area) of the slab. It shall only be provided, if the slab is rectangular.\X\0D\X\0A
NOTE  Also refered to as width, but not to be confused with the "Width" quantity, that denotes the thickness in the context of the slab.

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Perimeter measured along the outer boundaries of the slab. Only given, if the slab is prismatic (constant thickness).

properties.name: GrossArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded area of the slab. Openings, recesses and projections are not taken into account. Only given, if the slab is prismatic.

properties.name: NetArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded area of the slab. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition. Only given, if the slab is prismatic.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the slab. Openings, recesses, and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the slab. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the slab without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the slab without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_StairFlightBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of stair flights.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the stair flight along the walking line.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the stair flight. Openings, recesses, and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the stair flight. Openings and recesses are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition.

Qto_WallBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of walls.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total nominal length of the wall along the wall center line (even if different to the wall path).

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Total nominal width (or thickness) of the wall measured perpendicular to the wall path. It should only be provided, if it is constant along the wall path.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total nominal height of the wall. It should only be provided, if it is constant along the wall path.

properties.name: GrossFootprintArea
properties.description: Area of the wall as viewed by a ground floor view, not taking any wall modifications (like recesses) into account. It is also referred to as the foot print of the wall.

properties.name: NetFootprintArea
properties.description: Area of the wall as viewed by a ground floor view, taking all wall modifications (like recesses) into account. It is also referred to as the foot print of the wall.

properties.name: GrossSideArea
properties.description: Area of the wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the wall.  It does not take into account any wall modifications (such as openings).

properties.name: NetSideArea
properties.description: Area of the wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane. It does take into account all wall modifications (such as openings).

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Volume of the wall, without taking into account the openings and the connection geometry.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Volume of the wall, after subtracting the openings and after considering the connection geometry.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the wall, without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the wall, without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_WindowBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of windows.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Total outer width of the window lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular window.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total outer heigth of the window lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular window.

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Total perimeter of the outer lining of the window.

properties.name: Area
properties.description: Total area of the outer lining of the window.

Pset_AirSideSystemInformation.description: Attributes that apply to an air side HVAC system. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name of the air side system.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: The description of the air side system.

properties.name: AirSideSystemType
properties.description: This enumeration specifies the basic types of possible air side systems (e.g., Constant Volume, Variable Volume, etc.).

properties.name: AirSideSystemDistributionType
properties.description: This enumeration defines the basic types of air side systems (e.g., SingleDuct, DualDuct, Multizone, etc.).

properties.name: TotalAirflow
properties.description: The total design supply air flowrate required for the system for either heating or cooling conditions, whichever is greater.

properties.name: EnergyGainTotal
properties.description: The total amount of energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level total energy gains.

properties.name: AirflowSensible
properties.description: The air flowrate required to satisfy the sensible peak loads.

properties.name: EnergyGainSensible
properties.description: The sum of total energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level sensible energy gains.

properties.name: EnergyLoss
properties.description: The sum of energy losses for the spaces served by the system during the peak heating conditions.

properties.name: LightingDiversity
properties.description: Lighting diversity.

properties.name: InfiltrationDiversitySummer
properties.description: Diversity factor for Summer infiltration.

properties.name: InfiltrationDiversityWinter
properties.description: Diversity factor for Winter infiltration.

properties.name: ApplianceDiversity
properties.description: Diversity of appliance load.

properties.name: LoadSafetyFactor
properties.description: Load safety factor.

properties.name: HeatingTemperatureDelta
properties.description: Heating temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates.

properties.name: CoolingTemperatureDelta
properties.description: Cooling temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates.

properties.name: Ventilation
properties.description: Required outside air ventilation.

properties.name: FanPower
properties.description: Fan motor loads contributing to the cooling load.

Pset_DistributionChamberElementCommon.description: Common properties of all occurrences of IfcDistributionChamberElement.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specific instance (e.g.  'WWS/VS1/400/001', which indicates the occurrence belongs to system WWS, subsystems VSI/400, and has the component number 001).

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeForme.description: Space formed in the ground for the passage of pipes, cables, ducts.

properties.name: ClearWidth
properties.description: The width of the formed space in the duct.

properties.name: ClearDepth
properties.description: The depth of the formed space in the duct.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the duct wall construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the duct base construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that duct base will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: AccessCoverLoadRating
properties.description: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeInspe.description: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline and with a removable cover, that permits visible inspection.

properties.name: ChamberLengthOrRadius
properties.description: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

properties.name: ChamberWidth
properties.description: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

properties.name: InvertLevel
properties.description: Level of the lowest part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: SoffitLevel
properties.description: Level of the highest internal part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: WallMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber wall construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber base construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: WithBackdrop
properties.description: Indicates whether the chamber has a backdrop or tumbling bay (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: AccessCoverMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: AccessLengthOrRadius
properties.description: The length of the chamber access cover or, where the plan shape of the cover is circular, the radius.

properties.name: AccessWidth
properties.description: The width of the chamber access cover where the plan shape of the cover is not circular.

properties.name: AccessCoverLoadRating
properties.description: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeInspe.description: Recess or chamber formed to permit access for inspection of substructure and services (definition modified from BS6100 221 4128).

properties.name: Length
properties.description: The length of the pit.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: The width of the pit.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: The depth of the pit.

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeManho.description: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline and with a removable cover, that permits the entry of a person.

properties.name: InvertLevel
properties.description: Level of the lowest part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: SoffitLevel
properties.description: Level of the highest internal part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: WallMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber wall construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber base construction\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: IsShallow
properties.description: Indicates whether the chamber has been designed as being shallow (TRUE) or deep (FALSE).

properties.name: HasSteps
properties.description: Indicates whether the chamber has steps (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: WithBackdrop
properties.description: Indicates whether the chamber has a backdrop or tumbling bay (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: AccessCoverMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: AccessLengthOrRadius
properties.description: The length of the chamber access cover or, where the plan shape of the cover is circular, the radius.

properties.name: AccessWidth
properties.description: The width of the chamber access cover where the plan shape of the cover is not circular.

properties.name: AccessCoverLoadRating
properties.description: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeMeter.description: Chamber that houses a meter(s) (definition modified from BS6100 250 6224).

properties.name: ChamberLengthOrRadius
properties.description: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

properties.name: ChamberWidth
properties.description: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

properties.name: WallMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber wall construction\X\0A.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber base construction.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: AccessCoverMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeSump.description: Recess or small chamber into which liquid is drained to facilitate its removal.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: The length of the sump.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: The width of the sump.

properties.name: InvertLevel
properties.description: The lowest point in the cross section of the sump.

Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeTrenc.description: Excavation, the length of which greatly exceeds the width.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: The width of the trench.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: The depth of the trench.

properties.name: InvertLevel
properties.description: Level of the lowest part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: ChamberLengthOrRadius
properties.description: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

properties.name: ChamberWidth
properties.description: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

properties.name: WallMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber wall construction.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseMaterial
properties.description: The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.description: The thickness of the chamber base construction.\X\0ANOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: AccessCoverMaterial

Pset_DistributionPortCommon.description: Common attributes attached to an instance of IfcDistributionPort.

properties.name: PortNumber
properties.description: The port index for logically ordering the port within the containing element or element type.

properties.name: ColorCode
properties.description: Name of a color for identifying the connector, if applicable.

Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryCable.description: Log of electrical activity attached to an instance of IfcPerformanceHistory having an assigned IfcDistributionPort of type CABLE.

properties.name: Current
properties.description: Log of electrical current.

properties.name: Voltage
properties.description: Log of electrical voltage.

properties.name: RealPower
properties.description: Real power.

properties.name: ReactivePower
properties.description: Reactive power.

properties.name: ApparentPower
properties.description: Apparent power.

properties.name: PowerFactor
properties.description: Power factor.

properties.name: DataTransmitted

properties.name: ElectricalSystemType
properties.description: For certain purposes of electrical regulations, IEC 60364 defines types of system using type identifiers. Assignment of identifiers depends upon the relationship of the source, and of exposed conductive parts of the installation, to Ground (Earth).   Identifiers that may be assigned through IEC 60364 are: \X\0A\X\0A\X2\2022\X0\TN type system, a system having one or more points of the source of energy directly earthed, the exposed conductive parts of the installation being connected to that point by protective conductors, \X\0A\X2\2022\X0\TN C type system, a TN type system in which neutral and protective functions are combined in a single conductor throughout the system, \X\0A\X2\2022\X0\TN S type system, a TN type system having separate neutral and protective conductors throughout the system, \X\0A\X2\2022\X0\TN C S type system, a TN type system in which neutral and protective functions are combined in a single conductor in part of the system, \X\0A\X2\2022\X0\TT type system, a system having one point of the source of energy directly earthed, the exposed conductive parts of the installation being connected to earth electrodes electrically independent of the earth electrodes of the source, \X\0A\X2\2022\X0\IT type system, a system having no direct connection between live parts and Earth, the exposed conductive parts of the electrical installation being earthed.

properties.name: ElectricalSystemCategory
properties.description: Designates the voltage range of the circuit, according to IEC.  HIGHVOLTAGE indicates >1000V AC or >1500V DV; LOWVOLTAGE indicates 50-1000V AC or 120-1500V DC; EXTRALOWVOLTAGE indicates <50V AC or <120V DC.

properties.name: Diversity
properties.description: The ratio, expressed as a numerical\X\0Avalue or as a percentage, of the\X\0Asimultaneous maximum demand of\X\0Aa group of electrical appliances or\X\0Aconsumers within a specified period,\X\0Ato the sum of their individual maximum\X\0Ademands within the same\X\0Aperiod. The group of electrical appliances is in this case connected to this circuit. Defenition from IEC 60050, IEV 691-10-04 \X\0ANOTE1: It is often not desirable to size each conductor in a distribution system to support the total connected load at that point in the network. Diversity is applied on the basis of the anticipated loadings that are likely to result from all loads not being connected at the same time.\X\0ANOTE2: Diversity is applied to final circuits only, not to sub-main circuits supplying other DBs.

properties.name: NumberOfLiveConductors

The settings should limit the overall voltage drop to the required level. Default settings of 1.5% for sub-main circuits and 2.5% for final circuits, giving an overall limit of 4% may be applied.\X\0ANOTE: This value may also be specified as a constraint within an IFC model if required but is included within the property set at this stage pending implementation of the required capabilities within software applications.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: DeliveryType
properties.description: Determines how the accessory will be delivered to the site.

properties.name: CorrosionTreatment
properties.description: Determines corrosion treatment for metal components. This property is provided if the requirement needs to be expressed (a) independently of a material specification and (b) as a mere requirements statement rather than a workshop design/ processing feature.

properties.name: Type1
properties.description: Type of weld seam according to ISO 2553.  Note, combined welds are given by two corresponding symbols in the direction of the normal axis of the coordinate system.  For example, an X weld is specified by Type1 = 'V' and Type2 = 'V'.

properties.name: Type2
properties.description: See Type1.

properties.name: Surface1
properties.description: Aspect of weld seam surface, i.e. 'plane', 'curved' or 'hollow'.  Combined welds are given by two corresponding symbols analogous to Type1 and Type2.

properties.name: Surface2
properties.description: See Surface1.

properties.name: Process
properties.description: Reference number of the welding process according to ISO 4063, an up to three digits long code

properties.name: ProcessName
properties.description: Name of the welding process.  Alternative to the numeric Process property.

properties.name: a
properties.description: Measure a according to ISO 2553

properties.name: c
properties.description: Measure c according to ISO 2553

properties.name: d
properties.description: Measure d according to ISO 2553

properties.name: e
properties.description: Measure e according to ISO 2553

properties.name: l
properties.description: Measure l according to ISO 2553

properties.name: n
properties.description: Count n according to ISO 2553

properties.name: s
properties.description: Measure s according to ISO 2553

properties.name: z
properties.description: Measure z according to ISO 2553

properties.name: Intermittent
properties.description: If fillet weld, intermittent or not

properties.name: Staggered
properties.description: If intermittent weld, staggered or not

Pset_MechanicalFastenerAnchorBolt.description: Properties common to different types of anchor bolts.

properties.name: AnchorBoltLength
properties.description: The length of the anchor bolt.

properties.name: AnchorBoltDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter of the anchor bolt bar(s).

properties.name: AnchorBoltThreadLength
properties.description: The length of the threaded part of the anchor bolt.

properties.name: AnchorBoltProtrusionLength
properties.description: The length of the protruding part of the anchor bolt.

Pset_MechanicalFastenerBolt.description: Properties related to bolt-type fasteners. The properties of a whole set with bolt, washers and nut may be provided. Note, it is usually not necessary to transmit these properties in case of standardized bolts. Instead, the standard is referred to.

properties.name: ThreadDiameter
properties.description: Nominal diameter of the thread, if different from the bolt's overall nominal diameter

properties.name: ThreadLength
properties.description: Nominal length of the thread

properties.name: NutsCount
properties.description: Count of nuts to be mounted on one bolt

properties.name: WashersCount
properties.description: Count of washers to be mounted on one bolt

properties.name: HeadShape
properties.description: Shape of the bolt's head, e.g. 'Hexagon', 'Countersunk', 'Cheese'

properties.name: KeyShape
properties.description: If applicable, shape of the head's slot, e.g. 'Slot', 'Allen'

properties.name: NutShape
properties.description: Shape of the nut, e.g. 'Hexagon', 'Cap', 'Castle', 'Wing'

properties.name: WasherShape
properties.description: Shape of the washers, e.g. 'Standard', 'Square'

properties.name: NominalDiameter
properties.description: The nominal diameter describing the cross-section size of the fastener type.

properties.name: NominalLength
properties.description: The nominal length describing the longitudinal dimensions of the fastener type.

Pset_Asset.description: An asset is a uniquely identifiable element which has a financial value and against which maintenance actions are recorded.

properties.name: AssetAccountingType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: AssetTaxType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: AssetInsuranceType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

Pset_Condition.description: Determines the state or condition of an element at a particular point in time.

properties.name: AssessmentDate
properties.description: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: AssessmentCondition
properties.description: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: AssessmentDescription
properties.description: Qualitative description of the condition.

Pset_FurnitureTypeChair.description: A set of specific properties for furniture type chair. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Chair

properties.name: SeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height if the chair height is not adjustable.

properties.name: HighestSeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height of high level if the chair height is adjustable.

properties.name: LowestSeatingHeight
properties.description: The value of seating height of low level if the chair height is adjustable.

Pset_FurnitureTypeCommon.description: Common properties for all types of furniture such as chair, desk, table, and file cabinet. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureCommon. IFC 2x4: 'IsBuiltIn' property added

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Description of the furniture style.

properties.name: NominalHeight
properties.description: The nominal height of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalLength
properties.description: The nominal length of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalDepth
properties.description: The nominal depth of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: MainColor
properties.description: The main color of the furniture of this type.

properties.name: IsBuiltIn
properties.description: Indicates whether the furniture type is intended to be 'built in' i.e. physically attached to a building or facility (= TRUE) or not i.e. Loose and movable (= FALSE).

Pset_FurnitureTypeDesk.description: A set of specific properties for furniture type desk. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Desk

properties.name: WorksurfaceArea
properties.description: The value of the work surface area of the desk.

Pset_FurnitureTypeFileCabinet.description: A set of specific properties for furniture type file cabinet HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FileCabinet

properties.name: WithLock
properties.description: Indicates whether the file cabinet is lockable (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

Pset_FurnitureTypeTable.description: HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Table

properties.name: WorksurfaceArea
properties.description: The value of the work surface area of the desk..

properties.name: NumberOfChairs
properties.description: Maximum number of chairs that can fit with the table for normal use.

Pset_ManufacturerOccurrence.description: Defines properties of individual instances of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer.\X\0AHISTORY: IFC 2x4: AssemblyPlace property added. This property does not need to be asserted if Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation is allocated to the type and the AssemblyPlace property is asserted there.

properties.name: AcquisitionDate
properties.description: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

properties.name: BarCode
properties.description: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product.

properties.name: SerialNumber
properties.description: The serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product.

properties.name: BatchReference
properties.description: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

properties.name: AssemblyPlace
properties.description: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory, other offsite location or on the building site.

Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation.description: Defines characteristics of types (ranges) of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer. Note that the term 'manufactured' may also be used to refer to products that are supplied and identified by the supplier or that are assembled off site by a third party provider. \X\0AHISTORY: This property set replaces the entity IfcManufacturerInformation from previous IFC releases. IFC 2x4: AssemblyPlace property added.

properties.name: GlobalTradeItemNumber
properties.description: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is an identifier for trade items developed by GS1 (www.gs1.org).

properties.name: ArticleNumber
properties.description: Article number or reference that is be applied to a configured product according to a standard scheme for article number definition as defined by the manufacturer. It is often used as the purchasing number.

properties.name: ModelReference
properties.description: The model number or designator of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: ModelLabel
properties.description: The descriptive model name of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Manufacturer
properties.description: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

properties.name: ProductionYear
properties.description: The year of production of the manufactured item.

properties.name: AssemblyPlace
properties.description: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory or on the building site.

Pset_PropertyAgreement.description: A property agreement is an agreement that enables the occupation of a property for a period of time.\X\0A\X\0AThe objective is to capture the information within an  agreement that is relevant to a facilities manager. Design and construction information associated with the property is not considered. A property agreement may be applied to an instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement including to compositions defined through the IfcSpatialStructureElement.Element.CompositionEnum.\X\0A\X\0ANote that the associated actors are captured by the IfcOccupant class.

properties.name: AgreementType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of property agreement from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Identifier
properties.description: The identifier assigned to the agreement for the purposes of tracking.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: The version number of the agreement that is identified.

properties.name: VersionDate
properties.description: The date on which the version of the agreement became applicable.

properties.name: PropertyName
properties.description: Addressing details of the property as stated within the agreement.

properties.name: CommencementDate
properties.description: Date on which the agreement commences.

properties.name: TerminationDate
properties.description: Date on which the agreement terminates.

properties.name: Duration
properties.description: The period of time for the lease.

properties.name: Options
properties.description: A statement of the options available in the agreement.

properties.name: ConditionCommencement
properties.description: Condition of property provided on commencement of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key.

properties.name: Restrictions
properties.description: Restrictions that may be placed by a  competent authority.

properties.name: ConditionTermination
properties.description: Condition of property required on termination of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key.

Pset_Risk.description: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss. \X\0A\X\0AHISTORY: Extended in IFC2x3\X\0A\X\0AThere are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated in an instance of an IfcProcess.\X\0ASpecification of this property set incorporates the values of the Incom risk analysis matrix (satisfying AS/NZS 4360) together with additional identified requirements.

properties.name: RiskType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: NatureOfRisk
properties.description: An indication of the generic nature of the risk that might be encountered. \X\0A\X\0ANOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values that might be assigned to this property. An example might be 'Fall'  or 'Fall of grille unit' causing injury and damage to person and property.

properties.name: SubNatureOfRisk1
properties.description: A first subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk.\X\0A\X\0ANOTE: Nature of risk may be identified in various ways depending upon the place where risk assessment takes place and according to local agreement. This property set allows for a generic nature of risk and up to two subsidiary natures. An example might be 'causing injury and damage'.

properties.name: SubNatureOfRisk2
properties.description: A second subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk. An example might be 'o person and property'.

properties.name: RiskCause
properties.description: A value that may be assigned to capture the cause or trigger for the risk. An example might be 'poor fixing'.

properties.name: AssessmentOfRisk
properties.description: Likelihood of risk event occurring.\X\0A\X\0ANote  that assessment of risk may frequently be associated with the physical location of the object for which the risk is assessed.

properties.name: RiskConsequence
properties.description: Indicates the level of severity of the consequences that the risk would have in case it happens.

properties.name: RiskRating
properties.description: A general rating of the risk that may be determined from a combination of the risk assessment and risk consequence.

properties.name: RiskOwner
properties.description: A determination of who is the owner of the risk by reference to principal roles of organizations within a project. Determination of the specific organization should be by reference to instances of IfcActorRole assigned to instances of IfcOrganization (if assigned).

properties.name: AffectsSurroundings
properties.description: Indicates wether the risk affects only to the person assigned to that task (FALSE) or if it can also affect to the people in the surroundings (TRUE).\X\0A\X\0AFor example, the process of painting would affect all the people in the vicinity of the process.

properties.name: PreventiveMeassures
properties.description: Identifies preventive measures to be taken to mitigate risk.

Pset_ServiceLife.description: Captures the period of time that an artifact will last.  HISTORY: Introduced in IFC2X4 as replacement for IfcServiceLife.

properties.name: ServiceLifeDuration
properties.description: The length or duration of a service life.  \X\0D\X\0A\X\0D\X\0AThe lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: MeanTimeBetweenFailure
properties.description: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

Pset_ServiceLifeFactors.description: Captures various factors that impact the expected service life of elements within the system or zone.

properties.name: QualityOfComponents
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of components used.

properties.name: DesignLevel
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of design level employed.

properties.name: WorkExecutionLevel
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of work executed.

properties.name: IndoorEnvironment
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the indoor environment (where appropriate).

properties.name: OutdoorEnvironment
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the outdoor environment (where appropriate)

properties.name: InUseConditions
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the conditions in which components are operating.

properties.name: MaintenanceLevel
properties.description: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the level or degree of maintenance applied to dcomponents.

Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypeCommon.description: Common properties for all systems furniture (I.e. modular furniture) element types (e.g. vertical panels, work surfaces, and storage). HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_FurnitureElementCommon

properties.name: IsUsed
properties.description: Indicates whether the element is being used in a workstation (= TRUE) or not.(= FALSE).

properties.name: GroupCode
properties.description: e.g. panels, worksurfaces, storage, etc.

properties.name: NominalWidth
properties.description: The nominal width of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalHeight
properties.description: The nominal height of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Finishing
properties.description: The finishing applied to system furniture elements of this type e.g. walnut, fabric.

Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypePanel.description: A set of specific properties for vertical panels that assembly workstations.. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Panel

properties.name: HasOpening
properties.description: indicates whether the panel has an opening (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: FurniturePanelType
properties.description: Available panel types from which that required may be selected.

properties.name: NominalThickness
properties.description: The nominal thickness of the panel.

Pset_SystemFurnitureElementTypeWorkSurfa.description: A set of specific properties for work surfaces used in workstations. HISTORY: First issued in IFC Release R1.5. Renamed from Pset_Worksurface

properties.name: UsePurpose
properties.description: The principal purpose for which the work surface is intended to be used e.g. writing/reading, computer, meeting, printer, reference files, etc.

properties.name: SupportType
properties.description: Available support types from which that required may be selected.

properties.name: HangingHeight
properties.description: The hanging height of the worksurface.

properties.name: NominalThickness
properties.description: The nominal thickness of the work surface.

properties.name: ShapeDescription
properties.description: A description of the shape of the work surface e.g. corner square, rectangle, etc.

Pset_Warranty.description: An assurance given by the seller or provider of an artefact that the artefact is without defects and will operate as described for a defined period of time without failure and that if a defect does arise during that time, that it will be corrected by the seller or provider.

properties.name: WarrantyIdentifier
properties.description: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: WarrantyStartDate
properties.description: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: WarrantyEndDate
properties.description: The date on which the warranty expires.

properties.name: IsExtendedWarranty
properties.description: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: WarrantyPeriod
properties.description: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: WarrantyContent
properties.description: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: PointOfContact
properties.description: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.description: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

Pset_ActionRequest.description: An action request is a request for an action to fulfill a need.  HISTORY: IFC4: Removed RequestSourceType, RequestDescription, Status

properties.name: RequestSourceLabel
properties.description: A specific name or label that further qualifies the identity of a request source. In the event of an email, this may be the email address.

properties.name: RequestSourceName
properties.description: The person making the request, where known.

properties.name: RequestComments
properties.description: Comments that may be made on the request.

Pset_PackingInstructions.description: Packing instructions are specific instructions relating to the packing that is required for an artifact in the event of a move (or transport).

properties.name: PackingCareType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of care that may be required when handling the artefact during a move where:\X\0A\X\0AFragile: artefact may be broken during a move through careless handling.\X\0AHandleWithCare: artefact may be damaged during a move through careless handling.

properties.name: WrappingMaterial
properties.description: Special requirements for material used to wrap an artefact.

properties.name: ContainerMaterial
properties.description: Special requirements for material used to contain an artefact.

properties.name: SpecialInstructions
properties.description: Special instructions for packing.

Pset_Permit.description: A permit is a document that allows permission to gain access to an area or carry out work in a situation where security or other access restrictions apply.\X\0AHISTORY: IFC4 EndDate added. PermitType, PermitDuration, StartTime and EndTime are deleted.

properties.name: EscortRequirement
properties.description: Indicates whether or not an escort is required to accompany persons carrying out a work order at or to/from the place of work (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).\X\0A\X\0ANOTE - There are many instances where escorting is required, particularly in a facility that has a high security rating. Escorting may require that persons are escorted to and from the place of work. Alternatively, it may involve the escort remaining at the place of work at all times.

properties.name: StartDate
properties.description: Date and time from which the permit becomes valid.

properties.name: EndDate
properties.description: Date and time at which the permit ceases to be valid.

properties.name: SpecialRequirements
properties.description: Any additional special requirements that need to be included in the permit to work.\X\0A\X\0ANOTE - Additional permit requirements may be imposed according to the nature of the facility at which the work is carried out. For instance, in clean areas, special clothing may be required whilst in corrective institutions, it may be necessary to check in and check out tools that will be used for work as a safety precaution.

Pset_ProjectOrderChangeOrder.description: A change order is an instruction to make a change to a product or work being undertake. Note that the change order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a change order implies a work requirement.

properties.name: ReasonForChange
properties.description: A description of the problem for why a change is needed.

properties.name: BudgetSource
properties.description: The budget source requested.

Pset_ProjectOrderMaintenanceWorkOrder.description: A MaintenanceWorkOrder is a detailed description of maintenance work that is to be performed. Note that the Scheduled Frequency property of the maintenance work order is used when the order is required as an instance of a scheduled work order.

properties.name: ProductDescription
properties.description: A textual description of the products that require the work.

properties.name: WorkTypeRequested
properties.description: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

properties.name: ContractualType
properties.description: The contractual type of the work.

properties.name: IfNotAccomplished
properties.description: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

properties.name: MaintenaceType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of maintenance that can be done from which the type that generates the maintenance work order may be set where:\X\0A\X\0AConditionBased: generated as a result of the condition of an asset or artefact being less than a determined value.\X\0ACorrective: generated as a result of an immediate and urgent need for maintenance action.\X\0APlannedCorrective: generated as a result of immediate corrective action being needed but with sufficient time available for the work order to be included in maintenance planning.\X\0AScheduled: generated as a result of a fixed, periodic maintenance requirement.

properties.name: FaultPriorityType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:\X\0A\X\0AHigh: action is required urgently.\X\0AMedium: action can occur within a reasonable period of time.\X\0ALow: action can occur when convenient.

properties.name: LocationPriorityType
properties.description: Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:\X\0A\X\0AHigh: action is required urgently.\X\0AMedium: action can occur within a reasonable period of time.\X\0ALow: action can occur when convenient.

properties.name: ScheduledFrequency
properties.description: The period of time between expected instantiations of a work order that may have been predefined.

Pset_ProjectOrderMoveOrder.description: Defines the requirements for move orders. Note that the move order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a move order implies a work requirement.

properties.name: SpecialInstructions
properties.description: Special instructions that affect the move.

Pset_ProjectOrderPurchaseOrder.description: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.

properties.name: IsFOB
properties.description: Indication of whether contents of the purchase order are delivered 'Free on Board' (= True) or not (= False). FOB is a shipping term which indicates that the supplier pays the shipping costs (and usually also the insurance costs) from the point of manufacture to a specified destination, at which point the buyer takes responsibility.

properties.name: ShipMethod
properties.description: Method of shipping that will be used for goods or services.

Pset_ProjectOrderWorkOrder.description: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.

properties.name: ProductDescription
properties.description: A textual description of the products that require the work.

properties.name: WorkTypeRequested
properties.description: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

properties.name: ContractualType
properties.description: The contractual type of the work.

properties.name: IfNotAccomplished
properties.description: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

Pset_ActuatorPHistory.description: Properties for history of actuators. HISTORY: Added in IFC4.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Indicates position of the actuator over time where 0.0 is fully closed and 1.0 is fully open.

properties.name: Quality
properties.description: Indicates the quality of measurement or failure condition, which may be further qualified by the Status.  True: measured values are considered reliable; False: measured values are considered not reliable (i.e. a fault has been detected); Unknown: reliability of values is uncertain.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Indicates an error code or identifier, whose meaning is specific to the particular automation system.  Example values include: 'ConfigurationError', 'NotConnected', 'DeviceFailure', 'SensorFailure', 'LastKnown, 'CommunicationsFailure', 'OutOfService'.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), provided, if there is no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: FailPosition
properties.description: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

properties.name: ManualOverride
properties.description: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Indicates application of actuator.

Pset_ActuatorTypeElectricActuator.description: A device that electrically actuates a control element.

properties.name: ActuatorInputPower
properties.description: Maximum input power requirement.

properties.name: ElectricActuatorType
properties.description: Enumeration that identifies electric actuator as defined by its operational principle.

Pset_ActuatorTypeHydraulicActuator.description: A device that hydraulically actuates a control element.

properties.name: InputPressure
properties.description: Maximum design pressure for the actuator.

properties.name: InputFlowrate
properties.description: Maximum hydraulic flowrate requirement.

Pset_ActuatorTypeLinearActuation.description: Characteristics of linear actuation of an actuator\X\0AHistory: Replaces Pset_LinearActuator

properties.name: Force
properties.description: Indicates the maximum close-off force for the actuator.

properties.name: Stroke
properties.description: Indicates the maximum distance the actuator must traverse.

Pset_ActuatorTypePneumaticActuator.description: A device that pneumatically actuates a control element

properties.name: InputPressure
properties.description: Maximum input control air pressure requirement.

properties.name: InputFlowrate
properties.description: Maximum input control air flowrate requirement.

Pset_ActuatorTypeRotationalActuation.description: Characteristics of rotational actuation of an actuator\X\0AHistory: Replaces Pset_RotationalActuator

properties.name: Torque
properties.description: Indicates the maximum close-off torque for the actuator.

properties.name: RangeAngle
properties.description: Indicates the maximum rotation the actuator must traverse.

Pset_AlarmPHistory.description: Properties for history of alarm values.  HISTORY: Added in IFC4.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Indicates whether alarm is enabled or disabled over time.

properties.name: Condition
properties.description: Indicates alarm condition over time.  The range of possible values and their meanings is defined by Pset_AlarmTypeCommon.Condition.  An empty value indicates no present alarm condition.

properties.name: Severity
properties.description: Indicates alarm severity over time, where the scale of values is determined by the control system configuration.  A zero value indicates no present alarm.

properties.name: Acknowledge
properties.description: Indicates acknowledgement status where False indicates acknowlegement is required and outstanding, True indicates condition has been acknowedged, and Unknown indicates no acknowledgement is required.  Upon resetting the condition, then acknowledgement reverts to Unknown.

properties.name: User
properties.description: Indicates acknowledging user over time by identification corresponding to IfcPerson.Identification on an IfcActor.

Pset_AlarmTypeCommon.description: Alarm type common attributes.  HISTORY: Added in IFC4.

properties.name: Reference
properties.description: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), provided, if there is no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.

properties.name: Status

Pset_ControllerTypeFloating.description: Properties for signal handling for an analog controller taking disparate valued multiple inputs and creating a single valued output.  HISTORY: IFC4 adapted from Pset_ControllerTypeCommon and applicable predefined type made specific to FLOATING; ACCUMULATOR and PULSECONVERTER types added; additional properties added to replace Pset_AnalogInput and Pset_AnalogOutput.

properties.name: ControlType
properties.description: The type of signal modification effected and applicable ports: \X\0A\X\0ACONSTANT: No inputs; SignalOffset is written to the output value.\X\0AMODIFIER: Single analog input is read, added to SignalOffset, multiplied by SignalFactor, and written to the output value.\X\0AABSOLUTE: Single analog input is read and absolute value is written to the output value.\X\0AINVERSE: Single analog input is read, 1.0 is divided by the input value and written to the output value.\X\0AHYSTERISIS: Single analog input is read, delayed according to SignalTime, and written to the output value.\X\0ARUNNINGAVERAGE: Single analog input is read, averaged over SignalTime, and written to the output value.\X\0ADERIVATIVE: Single analog input is read and the rate of change during the SignalTime is written to the output value.\X\0AINTEGRAL: Single analog input is read and the average value during the SignalTime is written to the output value.\X\0ABINARY: Single binary input is read and SignalOffset is written to the output value if True.\X\0AACCUMULATOR: Single binary input is read, and for each pulse the SignalOffset is added to the accumulator, and while the accumulator is greater than the SignalFactor, the accumulator is decremented by SignalFactor and the integer result is incremented by one.\X\0APULSECONVERTER: Single integer input is read, and for each increment the SignalMultiplier is added and written to the output value.\X\0ASUM: Two analog inputs are read, added, and written to the output value.\X\0ASUBTRACT: Two analog inputs are read, subtracted, and written to the output value.\X\0APRODUCT: Two analog inputs are read, multiplied, and written to the output value.\X\0ADIVIDE: Two analog inputs are read, divided, and written to the output value.\X\0AAVERAGE: Two analog inputs are read and the average is written to the output value.\X\0AMAXIMUM: Two analog inputs are read and the maximum is written to the output value.\X\0AMINIMUM: Two analog inputs are read and the minimum is written to the output value..\X\0AINPUT: Controller element is a dedicated input.\X\0AOUTPUT: Controller element is a dedicated output.\X\0AVARIABLE: Controller element is an in-memory variable.
