properties.description: Length of the footing, not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features. For strip footings it is measured along the path, for other footings it is one of the horizontal dimensions. It should only be provided, if it is constant.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Total nominal width (or thickness) of the footing. For strip footings it is measured perpendicular to the footing path (or longitudial axis). For other footings it is one of the horizontal dimensions. It should only be provided, if it is constant.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Total nominal height of the footing. It should only be provided, if it is constant.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the footing.

properties.name: OuterSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded surfaces of the footing (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length.

properties.name: GrossSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the footing, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the footing, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the footing, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the footing without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the footing without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_PileBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of piles.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of the pile not taking into account any cut-out's or other processing features.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the pile.

properties.name: OuterSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the extruded surfaces of the pile (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length.

properties.name: GrossSurfaceArea
properties.description: Total area of the pile, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

properties.name: GrossVolume
properties.description: Total gross volume of the pile, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetVolume
properties.description: Total net volume of the pile, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: GrossWeight
properties.description: Total gross weight of the pile without add-on parts, not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: NetWeight
properties.description: Total net weight of the pile without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Qto_ReinforcingElementBaseQuantities.description: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of reinforcement.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Total count of reinforcing items.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Total length of reinforcing.

properties.name: Weight
properties.description: Total weight of reinforcing.

Pset_MaterialCombustion.description: A set of extended material properties of products of combustion generated by elements typically used within the context of building services and flow distribution systems.

properties.name: SpecificHeatCapacity
properties.description: Specific heat of the products of combustion: heat energy absorbed per temperature unit.

properties.name: N20Content
properties.description: Nitrous oxide (N2O) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of N2O per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

properties.name: COContent
properties.description: Carbon monoxide (CO) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of CO per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

properties.name: CO2Content
properties.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of CO2 per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

Pset_MaterialCommon.description: A set of general material properties.

properties.name: MolecularWeight
properties.description: Molecular weight of material (typically gas).

properties.name: Porosity
properties.description: The void fraction of the total volume occupied by material (Vbr - Vnet)/Vbr.

properties.name: MassDensity
properties.description: Material mass density.

Pset_MaterialConcrete.description: A set of extended mechanical properties related to concrete materials.

properties.name: CompressiveStrength
properties.description: The compressive strength of the concrete.

properties.name: MaxAggregateSize
properties.description: The maximum aggregate size of the concrete.

properties.name: AdmixturesDescription
properties.description: Description of the admixtures added to the concrete mix.

properties.name: Workability
properties.description: Description of the workability of the fresh concrete defined according to local standards.

properties.name: WaterImpermeability
properties.description: Description of the water impermeability denoting the water repelling properties.

properties.name: ProtectivePoreRatio
properties.description: The protective pore ratio indicating the frost-resistance of the concrete.

Pset_MaterialEnergy.description: A set of extended material properties for energy calculation purposes.

properties.name: ViscosityTemperatureDerivative
properties.description: Viscosity temperature derivative.

properties.name: MoistureCapacityThermalGradient
properties.description: Thermal gradient coefficient for moisture capacity. Based on water vapor density.

properties.name: ThermalConductivityTemperatureDerivative
properties.description: Thermal conductivity temperature derivative.

properties.name: SpecificHeatTemperatureDerivative
properties.description: Specific heat temperature derivative.

properties.name: VisibleRefractionIndex
properties.description: Index of refraction (visible) defines the "bending" of the sola! r ray in the visible spectrum when it passes from one medium into another.

properties.name: SolarRefractionIndex
properties.description: Index of refraction (solar) defines the "bending" of the solar ray when it passes from one medium into another.

properties.name: GasPressure
properties.description: Fill pressure (e.g. for between-pane gas fills): the pressure exerted by a mass of gas confined in a constant volume.

Pset_MaterialFuel.description: A set of extended material properties of fuel energy typically used within the context of building services and flow distribution systems.

properties.name: CombustionTemperature
properties.description: Combustion temperature of the material when air is at 298 K and 100 kPa.

properties.name: CarbonContent
properties.description: The carbon content in the fuel. This is measured in weight of carbon per unit weight of fuel and is therefore unitless.

properties.name: LowerHeatingValue
properties.description: Lower Heating Value is defined as the amount of energy released (MJ/kg) when a fuel is burned completely, and H2O is in vapor form in the combustion products.

properties.name: HigherHeatingValue
properties.description: Higher Heating Value is defined as the amount of energy released (MJ/kg) when a fuel is burned completely, and H2O is in liquid form in the combustion products.

Pset_MaterialHygroscopic.description: A set of hygroscopic properties of materials.

properties.name: UpperVaporResistanceFactor
properties.description: The vapor permeability relationship of air/material (typically value > 1), measured in high relative humidity (typically in 95/50 % RH).

properties.name: LowerVaporResistanceFactor
properties.description: The vapor permeability relationship of air/material (typically value > 1), measured in low relative humidity (typically in 0/50 % RH).

properties.name: IsothermalMoistureCapacity
properties.description: Based on water vapor density.

properties.name: VaporPermeability
properties.description: The rate of water vapor transmission per unit area per unit of vapor pressure differential under test conditions.

properties.name: MoistureDiffusivity
properties.description: Moisture diffusivity is a transport property that is frequently used in the hygrothermal analysis of building envelope components.

Pset_MaterialMechanical.description: A set of mechanical material properties normally used for structural analysis purpose. It contains all properties which are independent of the actual material type.

properties.name: DynamicViscosity
properties.description: A measure of the viscous resistance of the material.

properties.name: YoungModulus
properties.description: A measure of the Young's modulus of elasticity of the material.

properties.name: ShearModulus
properties.description: A measure of the shear modulus of elasticity of the material.

properties.name: PoissonRatio
properties.description: A measure of the lateral deformations in the elastic range.

properties.name: ThermalExpansionCoefficient
properties.description: A measure of the expansion coefficient for warming up the material about one Kelvin.

Pset_MaterialOptical.description: A set of optical properties of materials.

properties.name: VisibleTransmittance
properties.description: Transmittance at normal incidence (visible). Defines the fraction of the visible spectrum of solar radiation that passes through per unit area, perpendicular to the surface.

properties.name: SolarTransmittance
properties.description: Transmittance at normal incidence (solar). Defines the fraction of solar radiation that passes through per unit area, perpendicular to the surface.

properties.name: ThermalIrTransmittance
properties.description: Thermal IR transmittance at normal incidence. Defines the fraction of thermal energy that passes through per unit area, perpendicular to the surface.

properties.name: ThermalIrEmissivityBack
properties.description: Thermal IR emissivity: back side. Defines the fraction of thermal energy emitted per unit area to "blackbody" at the same temperature, through the "back" side of the material.

properties.name: ThermalIrEmissivityFront
properties.description: Thermal IR emissivity: front side. Defines the fraction of thermal energy emitted per unit area to "blackbody" at the same temperature, through the "front" side of the material.

properties.name: VisibleReflectanceBack
properties.description: Reflectance at normal incidence (visible): back side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray in the visible spectrum that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "back" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

properties.name: VisibleReflectanceFront
properties.description: Reflectance at normal incidence (visible): front side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray in the visible spectrum that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "front" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

properties.name: SolarReflectanceBack
properties.description: Reflectance at normal incidence (solar): back side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "back" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

properties.name: SolarReflectanceFront
properties.description: Reflectance at normal incidence (solar): front side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "front" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

Pset_MaterialSteel.description: A set of extended mechanical properties related to steel (or other metallic and isotropic) materials.

properties.name: YieldStress
properties.description: A measure of the yield stress (or characteristic 0.2 percent proof stress) of the material.

properties.name: UltimateStress
properties.description: A measure of the ultimate stress of the material.

properties.name: UltimateStrain
properties.description: A measure of the (engineering) strain at the state of ultimate stress of the material.

properties.name: HardeningModule
properties.description: A measure of the hardening module of the material (slope of stress versus strain curve after yield range).

properties.name: ProportionalStress
properties.description: A measure of the proportional stress of the material. It describes the stress before the first plastic deformation occurs and is commonly measured at a deformation of 0.01%.

properties.name: PlasticStrain
properties.description: A measure of the permanent displacement, as in slip or twinning, which remains after the stress has been removed. Currently applied to a strain of 0.2% proportional stress of the material.

properties.name: Relaxations
properties.description: Measures of decrease in stress over long time intervals resulting from plastic flow. Different relaxation values for different initial stress levels for a material may be given. It describes the time dependent relative relaxation value for a given initial stress level at constant strain.\X\0ARelating values are the "RelaxationValue". Related values are the "InitialStress"

Pset_MaterialThermal.description: A set of thermal material properties.

properties.name: SpecificHeatCapacity
properties.description: Defines the specific heat of the material: heat energy absorbed per temperature unit.

properties.name: BoilingPoint
properties.description: The boiling point of the material (fluid).

properties.name: FreezingPoint
properties.description: The freezing point of the material (fluid).

properties.name: ThermalConductivity
properties.description: The rate at which thermal energy is transmitted through the material.

Pset_MaterialWater.description: A set of extended material properties for of water typically used within the context of building services and flow distribution systems.

properties.name: IsPotable
properties.description: If TRUE, then the water is considered potable.

properties.name: Hardness
properties.description: Water hardness as positive, multivalent ion concentration in the water (usually concentrations of calcium and magnesium ions in terms of calcium carbonate).

properties.name: AlkalinityConcentration
properties.description: Maximum alkalinity concentration (maximum sum of concentrations of each of the negative ions substances measured as CaCO3).

properties.name: AcidityConcentration
properties.description: Maximum CaCO3 equivalent that would neutralize the acid.

properties.name: ImpuritiesContent
properties.description: Fraction of impurities such as dust to the total amount of water. This is measured in weight of impurities per weight of water and is therefore unitless.

properties.name: DissolvedSolidsContent
properties.description: Fraction of the dissolved solids to the total amount of water. This is measured in weight of dissolved solids per weight of water and is therefore unitless.

properties.name: PHLevel
properties.description: Maximum water PH in a range from 0-14.

Pset_MaterialWood.description: This is a collection of properties applicable to wood-based materials that specify kind and grade of material as well as moisture related parameters.

properties.name: Species
properties.description: Wood species of a solid wood or laminated wood product.

properties.name: StrengthGrade
properties.description: Grade with respect to mechanical strength and stiffness.

properties.name: AppearanceGrade
properties.description: Grade with respect to visual quality.

properties.name: Layup
properties.description: Configuration of the lamination.

properties.name: Layers
properties.description: Number of layers.

properties.name: Plies
properties.description: Number of plies.

properties.name: MoistureContent
properties.description: Total weight of moisture relative to oven-dried weight of the wood.

properties.name: DimensionalChangeCoefficient
properties.description: Weighted dimensional change coefficient, relative to 1% change in moisture content.

properties.name: ThicknessSwelling
properties.description: Swelling ratio relative to board depth.

Pset_MaterialWoodBasedBeam.description: This is a collection of mechanical properties applicable to wood-based materials for beam-like products, especially laminated materials like glulam and LVL.\X\0AAnisotropy of such materials is taken into account by different properties according to grain direction and load types.\X\0A\X\0AAll values shall be given for a standardized service condition, a standardized load duration and a standardized reference size of the member according to local design codes.\X\0A\X\0ANOTE: In cases where mechanical material properties are graduated for different given reference sizes, separate instances of IfcExtendedMaterialProperties and IfcMaterial have to be used for each required graduation. Mechanically differing versions of a material are treated as different materials.\X\0A\X\0AReferences to the orientation of grain or lay-up correspond to material orientation given by geometrical or topological representation of element objects or types, especially IfcMemberType and IfcStructuralMember.

properties.name: ApplicableStructuralDesignMethod
properties.description: Determines whether mechanical material properties are applicable to 'ASD' = allowable stress design (working stress design), 'LSD' = limit state design, or 'LRFD' = load and resistance factor design.

Pset_MaterialWoodBasedPanel.description: This is a collection of mechanical properties related to wood-based materials for panel-like products like plywood or OSB. The propositions given above for wood-based beam materials with respect to anisotropy, strength graduation according to element sizes (especially panel thickness) apply accordingly.

properties.name: ApplicableStructuralDesignMethod
properties.description: Determines whether mechanical material properties are applicable to 'ASD' = allowable stress design (working stress design), 'LSD' = limit state design, or 'LRFD' = load and resistance factor design.

Pset_ProfileArbitraryDoubleT.description: This is a collection of geometric properties of double-T section profiles of precast concrete elements, to be used in conjunction with IfcArbitraryProfileDef when profile designation alone does not fulfill the information requirements.

properties.name: OverallWidth
properties.description: Overall width of the profile.

properties.name: LeftFlangeWidth
properties.description: Left flange width of the profile.

properties.name: RightFlangeWidth
properties.description: Right flange width of the profile.

properties.name: OverallDepth
properties.description: Overall depth of the profile.

properties.name: FlangeDepth
properties.description: Flange depth of the profile.

properties.name: FlangeDraft
properties.description: Flange draft of the profile.

properties.name: FlangeChamfer
properties.description: Flange chamfer of the profile.

properties.name: FlangeBaseFillet
properties.description: Flange base fillet of the profile.

properties.name: FlangeTopFillet
properties.description: Flange top fillet of the profile.

properties.name: StemBaseWidth
properties.description: Stem base width of the profile.

properties.name: StemTopWidth
properties.description: Stem top width of the profile.

properties.name: StemBaseChamfer
properties.description: Stem base chamfer of the profile.

properties.name: StemTopChamfer
properties.description: Stem top chamfer of the profile.

properties.name: StemBaseFillet
properties.description: Stem base fillet of the profile.

properties.name: StemTopFillet
properties.description: Stem top fillet of the profile.

Pset_ProfileArbitraryHollowCore.description: This is a collection of geometric properties of hollow core section profiles of precast concrete elements, to be used in conjunction with IfcArbitraryProfileDefWithVoids when profile designation alone does not fulfill the information requirements.  \X\0A\X\0AIn all cases, the cores are symmetrically distributed on either side of the plank center line, irrespective of whether the number of cores is odd or even. For planks with a center core with different geometry to that of the other cores, provide the property CenterCoreSpacing. When the number of cores is even, no Center Core properties shall be asserted.\X\0A\X\0AKey chamfers and draft chamfer are all 45 degree chamfers.\X\0A\X\0AThe CoreTopRadius and CoreBaseRadius parameters can be derived and are therefore not listed in the property set. They are shown to define that the curves are arcs. The parameters for the center core are the same as above, but with the prefix "Center".

properties.name: OverallWidth
properties.description: Overall width of the profile.

properties.name: OverallDepth
properties.description: Overall depth of the profile.

properties.name: EdgeDraft
properties.description: Edge draft of the profile.

properties.name: DraftBaseOffset
properties.description: Draft base offset of the profile.

properties.name: DraftSideOffset
properties.description: Draft side offset of the profile.

properties.name: BaseChamfer
properties.description: Base chamfer of the profile.

properties.name: KeyDepth
properties.description: Key depth of the profile.

properties.name: KeyHeight
properties.description: Key height of the profile.

properties.name: KeyOffset
properties.description: Key offset of the profile.

properties.name: BottomCover
properties.description: Bottom cover of the profile.

properties.name: CoreSpacing
properties.description: Core spacing of the profile.

properties.name: CoreBaseHeight
properties.description: Core base height of the profile.

properties.name: CoreMiddleHeight
properties.description: Core middle height of the profile.

properties.name: CoreTopHeight
properties.description: Core top height of the profile.

properties.name: CoreBaseWidth
properties.description: Core base width of the profile.

properties.name: CoreTopWidth
properties.description: Core top width of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreSpacing
properties.description: Center core spacing of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreBaseHeight
properties.description: Center core base height of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreMiddleHeight
properties.description: Center core middle height of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreTopHeight
properties.description: Center core top height of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreBaseWidth
properties.description: Center core base width of the profile.

properties.name: CenterCoreTopWidth
properties.description: Center core top width of the profile.

properties.name: NumberOfCores
properties.description: Number of cores.

Pset_ProfileMechanical.description: This is a collection of mechanical properties that are applicable to virtually all profile classes. Most of these properties are especially used in structural analysis.

properties.name: MassPerLength
properties.description: Mass per length, i.e. mass of a beam with a unit length of extrusion. For example measured in kg/m.

properties.name: CrossSectionArea
properties.description: Area of the profile. For example measured in mm2. If given, the value of the cross section area shall be greater than zero.

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Perimeter of the profile for calculating the surface area. For example measured in mm.

properties.name: MinimumPlateThickness
properties.description: This value may be needed for stress analysis and to handle buckling problems. It can also be derived from the given profile geometry or classification and therefore it is only an optional feature allowing for an explicit description. For example measured in mm.

properties.name: MaximumPlateThickness
properties.description: This value may be needed for stress analysis and to handle buckling problems. It can also be derived from the given profile geometry or classification and therefore it is only an optional feature allowing for an explicit description. For example measured in mm.

properties.name: CentreOfGravityInX
properties.description: Location of the profile's centre of gravity (geometric centroid), measured along xp.

properties.name: CentreOfGravityInY
properties.description: Location of the profile's centre of gravity (geometric centroid), measured along yp.

properties.name: ShearCentreZ
properties.description: Location of the profile's shear centre, measured along zs.

properties.name: ShearCentreY
properties.description: Location of the profile's shear centre, measured along ys.

properties.name: MomentOfInertiaY
properties.description: Moment of inertia about ys (second moment of area, about ys). For example measured in mm4.

properties.name: MomentOfInertiaZ
properties.description: Moment of inertia about zs (second moment of area, about zs). For example measured in mm4

properties.name: MomentOfInertiaYZ
properties.description: Moment of inertia about ys and zs (product moment of area). For example measured in mm4.

properties.name: TorsionalConstantX
properties.description: Torsional constant about xs. For example measured in mm4.

properties.name: WarpingConstant
properties.description: Warping constant of the profile for torsional action. For example measured in mm6.

properties.name: ShearDeformationAreaZ
properties.description: Area of the profile for calculating the shear deformation due to a shear force parallel to zs. For example measured in mm\S\2. If given, the shear deformation area zs shall be non-negative.

properties.name: ShearDeformationAreaY
properties.description: Area of the profile for calculating the shear deformation due to a shear force parallel to ys. For example measured in mm\S\2. If given, the shear deformation area ys shall be non-negative.

properties.name: MaximumSectionModulusY
properties.description: Bending resistance about the ys axis at the point with maximum zs ordinate. For example measured in mm\S\3.

properties.name: MinimumSectionModulusY
properties.description: Bending resistance about the ys axis at the point with minimum zs ordinate. For example measured in mm\S\3.

properties.name: MaximumSectionModulusZ
properties.description: Bending resistance about the zs axis at the point with maximum ys ordinate. For example measured in mm\S\3.

properties.name: MinimumSectionModulusZ
properties.description: Bending resistance about the zs axis at the point with minimum ys ordinate. For example measured in mm\S\3.

properties.name: TorsionalSectionModulus
properties.description: Torsional resistance (about xs). For example measured in mm\S\3.

properties.name: ShearAreaZ
properties.description: Area of the profile for calculating the shear stress due to shear force parallel to the section analysis axis zs. For example measured in mm\S\2. If given, the shear area zs shall be non-negative.

properties.name: ShearAreaY
properties.description: Area of the profile for calculating the shear stress due to shear force parallel to the section analysis axis ys. For example measured in mm\S\2. If given, the shear area ys shall be non-negative.

properties.name: PlasticShapeFactorY
properties.description: Ratio of plastic versus elastic bending moment capacity about the section analysis axis ys. A dimensionless value.

properties.name: PlasticShapeFactorZ
properties.description: Ratio of plastic versus elastic bending moment capacity about the section analysis axis zs. A dimensionless value.
